In 1984 I observed a convergence of three areas of focus in
our society:

EFTA00317455

 •

Technology business,

•

Entertainment industry, and

•

Design professions

When these three interests came together with passion and
quality, an explosion of new media, innovations, and
understandings of new patterns emerged.
In 1984 I invented TED to explore this personal journey.
The journey will continue in 2012.
Now more than ever, understanding converging patterns is
crucial to
understanding both our natural and man-made worlds.

I have

created WWW.WWW as a means of understanding the complexity
of the myriad of patterns inherent in all these
convergences.

The first bold W is for the world itself.
World
Waste
Wealth
Water
War
Well-Being
Wildlife
Web
Weather
Wind
Words
Wonder
Wilderness

EFTA00317456

 Work
Warming
Wit
Wanderlust & the
Waking Dream

Issues related to these fields constitute daily headlines
around the world.

Some predict doomsday, others solutions.

Understanding Precedes Action.

At WWW.WWW, the patterns and pairings between these various
disciplines will be explained, discussed and visualized.

The gathering will be comprised of informed, immersive and
improvised conversations between the greatest, most
interesting and curious minds in the world.

The structure will be that of jazz:

there shall be no

speeches, but rather unrehearsed conversation between
carefully selected pairings of great minds, sometimes from
the same field, sometimes from different disciplines and
divergent points of view. The pairs of individuals will be
asked questions to find commentary, out-of-the-box
observations, questions, successes and failures.
Discussions will be inventive and unpredictable.

These improvised conversations will flow in a path
throughout the gathering. Parallel with these conversations
will be actual performances given by the greatest musical

EFTA00317457

 pairings in the world. The gathered group of geniuses will
constitute a new form of jazz:

Intellectual jazz.

It will be an active gathering of great minds. There will
be a surround of visual reinforcement content, data,
statistics and images that will extend the understanding
and make the complex clear.

These images will be displayed

and triggered by key words in the conversations.

This event will be deeply guided but not rehearsed.

The

conversations might last 3 minutes or 30 minutes.

There

will be no set time.

It will be orchestrated depending on

the energy of the conversations the discovery of patterns
by what I hear by perhaps questions from the audience with
the possibility that the players on stage might reappear
later on or might be grouped with others.

This will need

appropriate investigation in order to make these decisions
on the fly.

Possible Pairings

In a classic improvisation or conversation the two
participants might come from the following:
•

two radically different points of view

•

two extremes in scale or magnitude of a similar
subject

•

two similar areas which amplify in depth a similar
subject

EFTA00317458

 •

two radically different scales from a line of inquiry
or research

•

from the same field or differing fields

•

from the same field and have differing points of view

•

they could be young and old

•

they can be a young bloomer or a late bloomer.

For example:

a pairing could be a cosmologist and a

microbiologist.

The cosmologist focused on developing the

means to discover the presence and measurement of the most
distant objects in space based on their light, heat or
various wavelengths.

His/her focus would be on the tools

that one develops to measure objects and the relationship
of objects to each other by how they change their paths
perhaps by gravitational pull, like planets around a star,
color of wavelength of light or directionality.

The microbiologist, on the other hand, would explain
developing the means to measure the heat, chemical make up
and growth patterns at the level of the neuron, small
genetic material, virus or protein case and the effect that
these have on regular and irregular growth patterns as in
cancer.

So at these two extremes of scales of inquiry about
measurement observation and discovery where the question
between them would be an intellectually amplified
realization of their journeys.
